Friend 1 said, "This trophy is mine! I saw it first!"
Friend 2 said, "No, it's mine. I got here first."

The two of them started to argue, and their voices got louder and louder. Suddenly, the ground started to twist and shake, which scared them. They quickly looked around and noticed a grown-up watching them from nearby.

The grown-up said, "You are both very polite for caring about the trophy, but fighting isn't the right way to solve a problem." The two friends looked embarrassed and nodded, so the grown-up said, "Why don't you take turns using the trophy? That way, you can both enjoy it."

The two friends were amazed at the grown-up's idea, and they thanked him by smiling and nodding. The grown-up left, and after that the two friends used the trophy to play tag. Every time they used the trophy, they were careful to share it politely.

Once upon a time, there was a beetle who lived in a forest. He was a brave and adventurous beetle. One day, he wanted to explore a different part of the forest. As he walked, he heard a noise coming from a bush. He looked in and saw a small mouse. The mouse was scared, so the beetle asked what was wrong. 

The mouse replied, "I am scared of the darkness. I am afraid to go home". The beetle thought for a moment then said, "It is okay to be afraid. But sometimes you have to be brave, especially when things seem scary." 

The beetle looked around, then he noticed something. A few light beams were coming into the bush! He told the mouse, "See the lights? The darkness is not so scary if you can see the light." The mouse looked up, and he smiled. 

The beetle said goodbye and went on his way. As he walked, he smiled too. He knew that he had taught the mouse an important lesson - even in the darkness, you can find something to be brave about.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Molly. She was brave and ready to try new things. One day, she saw a woman in a beautiful garden filled with flowers and buzzing insects. She wanted to go and talk to her but she didn't know what to say.

Molly took a deep breath and asked the woman: "What is wisdom?" The woman smiled and said: "Wisdom is inside you, Molly. It will help guide you in life!"

Molly was unsure but she was ready to find out more. She asked the woman again: "How do I get wisdom?" The woman said: "The only way to get wisdom is to tear away the things that make it difficult to find it."

Molly thought for a moment and then she understood. She said: "Thank you for your wise words!" The woman smiled and nodded.

Molly left the garden with a sense of new understanding. She was ready to start tearing away what was getting in the way of her wisdom. She was ready to start her new journey.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl who was very anxious about trying new things. One day, she wanted to help her mum repair a broken knob on the kitchen cabinet. When she asked her mum for help, her mum was scared she was too young to try.

The little girl said, â€œI can do it mum! I have seen you do it before. Please let me try!â€ Her mum replied, â€œAlright, but be careful.â€

The little girl was very careful and followed every step that her mum showed her. Eventually, she was able to repair the knob. The little girl was very proud of herself and her mum was proud too.

The moral of this story is to never give up on trying something new. It may seem hard but with courage, persistence and help from a special someone, you can achieve great things.

One winter day, Jack and his mom were going to celebrate his third birthday. He was so excited he put on his mittens and went outside to play in the snow. 
Jack found a friend there and they started playing together. His mom was watching from afar, feeling happy and generous. Suddenly, the friend stumbled and the mitten slipped off Jack's hand. 
Jack said to his mom: "Mommy, my mitten is gone!" She quickly replied: "It's okay. Let's find it!" He looked everywhere but couldn't find it anywhere. 
His mom then said: "I'm sorry, Jack. We'll have to say goodbye to your mitten. Let's be generous and give a sincere wish for whoever finds it." 
Jack was sad, but they both celebrated his birthday, even though he had no mitten. Jack learned the importance of being generous and wishing the best to the ones you hold dear.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tom. Tom was 3 years old and his parents had just bought him a new toy. It was a big, shiny computer. Tom was so happy because he liked to play games on it. 

Tom asked his mum and dad if he could play right away. They said yes, so Tom went to the computer and switched it on. Suddenly, a big screen came up with lots of lights and colours. Tom was so excited, he started to yell in delight. 

Tom started to move the mouse around and click on things. The screen changed every time he clicked. He was playing a game where he had to find the right colours to solve puzzles. 

Suddenly, something went wrong. Tom was so scared that he stopped yelling and became very quiet. He didn't know what to do. 

His mum saw what had happened and quickly came to help him. She showed him where he had gone wrong and helped him fix the game. Tom then started to yell once again and was very happy when his game was working again.

Once there was a little boy. His name was Jack. One day, Jack had an idea. He wanted to make a joke and go to his neighbor's garden.

So Jack went to his neighbor's garden. But it was dead. There were no flowers and plants. Jack felt sad. He asked his neighbor why the garden was so dead.

The neighbor said, "I never take care of the garden. I don't have time."

So Jack and his neighbor worked together and soon, the garden was beautiful and alive again.

Jack and his neighbor were so happy to see the garden look like new. They both smiled and agreed that it was the best joke ever!

Mum and Dad were packing for a trip.

Mum said to Dad, "Let's get the egg in the suitcase."

Dad agreed and took an egg out of the fridge. The egg was big and round.

Mum said, "It's so big. I have a sweet idea. We could share the egg on the plane!"

They packed the presents quickly and soon they were ready.

Mum said, "Let's eat the egg now. It's so sweet!"

Dad agreed, and they ate the egg together.

Mum and Dad smiled, excited for their trip.

Jimmy was walking his puppy in the park. His puppy was very excited and wanted to explore the park. As Jimmy and his puppy walked in the park, Jimmy saw a bush that was very tall. He and his puppy stopped to take a look.

Suddenly, a man and his dog came and stood next to them. Jimmy noticed that the man's dog was not wearing a leash. The man then said in a gentle voice, â€œIt is important to share the park with everyone, this means that all dogs must have a leash.â€

Jimmy knew that he had made a mistake by taking off the leash. He put the leash back on his puppy and realized that he should always be considerate and share

Once upon a time, there was a barber who had never met anyone like him before. He was different in a very special way. Every day he used to strike his clippers and comb his hair.

The barber smiled and said, "Of course!" He motioned for her to come in and take a seat. He then began to strike his clippers and comb her hair. He was careful to not make it too short. 

When he was done, the little girl said, "Thank you! It looks so different!" The barber smiled and said, "You're welcome! Come back anytime!"  


The little girl left with a new haircut and the barber felt happy. He liked giving people haircuts and making them look different. He thought it was the best job ever.

Once there was a boy. He didn't know what a pit was, but he soon found out. One day, he and his mom were in the park. He saw a big, round, empty pit. It was very strange and he was curious. He asked his mom, "What is that?" She said, "That's a pit, my love. It's so deep and empty." 

The boy was amazed. He wanted to explore it, so he asked his mom if he could. She said yes. He walked to the edge of the pit and stared into it. He felt so small. He put his hands on the edge and looked down. It was so deep, but he wasn't scared. 

The boy knew he wanted to climb down. He asked his mom if he could and she said yes. He was so excited. He grabbed a big stick and started to carefully climb down. He looked around as he went. He could see all the way to the bottom and there were lots of interesting rocks and pebbles. 

Reaching the bottom, the boy felt so proud. He knew he had achieved something great. He showed his mom what he had discovered and she was so proud of him too. Together, they climbed back out of the pit. It was an adventure the boy would never forget.

John was overjoyed when he saw the mixer. It was shiny and blue with a long cord that seemed to go forever. He wanted to touch it, but his mommy said to be gentle because it was fragile.

John asked, "What can I do with it?"

Mommy smiled, "It's a kitchen mixer. You can use it to mix different things together. It will excite your taste buds!"

John was so excited to try it out that he couldn't wait to start cooking. He spent the next few days using the mixer to make lots of delicious treats. Every time he was able to mix things together it brought a big smile to his face. He never tired of feeling the excitement the mixer brought him.

Once upon a time, there was a mysterious girl who lived in a forest. Every day she would go for long walks and discover amazing things.

The girl was sad that she had to leave, but she thanked the spirit for his mysterious help. With a sparkle and a twinkle, the spirit melted away.

One day, little Jack went to the market. As he walked along, he noticed something in the corner. It was very peculiar and it seemed to sparkle.

He decided to examine it more closely. As he examined it, Jack could see it was something special and quite original.

As he picked it up, Jack heard a voice.

Once upon a time, there was a squirrel living in the forest. Every day, the squirrel would go out and look for food.

One day, the squirrel saw something glimmering amongst the trees. When he got closer, he realised it was a recorder. He picked it up and played with it, trying to record different sounds like the birds singing or the wind blowing in the trees.

The next day, the squirrel heard the little boy who lived in the nearby village calling out his name. He quickly ran away and hid in a tree, feeling guilty but not sure why.

The little boy saw the squirrel and started to follow him. When the boy realised the squirrel was carrying something in his hands, he shouted: "Hey squirrel! Give that recorder back!"

The squirrel stopped and looked at the little boy guiltily. He didn't want to give it back, but he knew he had to. He carefully placed it in the boy's hands and the boy smiled.

"Thank you, squirrel!" the little boy said. "I'm glad you were honest and gave it back." 

The squirrel nodded and ran away happily, knowing that he had done the right thing.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Bella. She loved playing outside. One day, she went to the park with her mom. As she played on the swings, she saw an apple on the ground. She ran over and picked it up. 

When Bella bit into the apple, she tasted something funny. It tasted fake! She looked up and saw a funny man with a red beard, he was holding a box of fake apples! 

The man started to yell, "They're all fake, they're not real! Get out of here!"

Bella was scared and ran back to her mom. She told her mom all about the fake apples.

Bella and her mom started laughing. They left the park feeling happy. 

Thanks to the funny man, Bella had a great day at the park.

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and loved to explore the world around her. One day, she was out looking for an adventure. Suddenly, she heard a loud, noisy noise coming from the top of a hill. She hopped up the hill and saw a bird with a long neck. The bird kept sorting through the leaves on the ground.

The bird smiled, and said, "That would be great!"

Lucys smiled and said, "You're welcome! It was fun helping you sort!"

Tim and his mom were in the store. Tim saw a great pair of pants. He asked his mom if he could get them. His mom said, "Yes, those look great on you." 

Tim was so excited. He put them on and hopped up and down saying, "Look, Mommy, look how I stand in them!" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, you look very handsome in those pants. Great job!" 

Tim was so proud of himself. He asked one more time if he could keep the pants. His mom said, "Yes, let's get them. You look super sharp in them!" 

Tim was so happy. He said, "I love my new pants!" 

His mom said, "I'm glad you love them. They look great on you!" 

Tim was the happiest he had ever been. Now he had a great pair of pants to show off to his friends.

One day, Sophia and her Dad were walking around the park. All of a sudden, Sophia saw something that made her very excited. It was a bucket! She wanted it so badly and started running towards the bucket. Her Dad laughed as he watched her run. 

When she finally got to the bucket, she was so happy! She picked it up and started running around with it, going in circles and getting dizzy. She laughed as she spun in circles. Suddenly she got so dizzy that she fell down, holding the bucket tightly.

Finally, Dad said, "Okay, if you take care of the bucket, you can bring it home." Sophia was so happy she jumped up and down. She hugged the bucket tightly and never let go of it until she was back home.

David liked to play with his new kite. He brought it to the park and ran to the top of the hill. The sky was quiet and blue. 

When David got to the top, he said "Today I will create something beautiful!" 

He stretched out the kite, laughing as it caught the breeze. He held the string between his hands and watched the kite fly.

"Look at me, I am creating a work of art so high in the sky!" David shouted. He watched the kite twist and turn and dip in the air. 

Finally David's mother shouted for him to come back down. With a heavy heart, he let go of the string and the kite soon disappeared. He had created something magical.

John was very tired. He had worked all day. John was a delivery man and he was delivering pants. He took the pants to the store. He put the pants in a box and then put them in his truck.

John drove his truck to the store. He was tired and he wanted to go home. John parked his truck and took the box of pants in to the store. The store manager thanked John for bringing the pants and gave him a big smile.

John thanked the manager, put the box of pants in the store and then went home. He was happy to have delivered the pants and to be home. John took a long nap and felt much better after that.

The man had to fight the monster and there was a long and difficult battle. But the man was powerful and fierce and he eventually defeated the monster. He grabbed the spirit and delivered it to the voice from above.

The voice was pleased and thanked the man for his bravery. And the man was glad that he had done something so brave and he knew he had been very powerful.

Once upon a time there was an old wise tree. Every morning he would sit in his favourite spot, watching the birds fly and the animals playing in the fields.

One day, a little girl called Sarah came up to the tree. She looked sad and didn't know what to do. She turned to the tree and said,

"I'm feeling so low, tree. Can you help me feel better?"

The tree smiled and said kindly,

"Yes, my dear. I can help. All you need to do is promise to look after the animals and birds around you every day. It will make them very happy and make you happy too."

Sarah smiled and said,

"I promise, tree. I'll take care of them every day."

The tree smiled again and said, 
"As a reward for your promise, here's a lovely piece of chocolate for you. Enjoy it!"

Sarah thanked the tree and happily ate the chocolate. She still kept her promise and looked after the animals and birds every day.

Moral of the Story:
When you keep your promise, it makes you and those around you happy.

Jenna was riding her bike around the playground. She saw a big, tall structure in the middle of the field and wanted to try it. She rode her bike up to it and saw that it was an old football goal. She asked her dad if she could try it. Her dad looked around and said, "Yes, we can give it a go".

Jenna was excited and quickly got off her bike and started running towards the structure. She saw there were two posts and a net. Jenna quickly got to the back of the structure and started kicking the ball.

The ball was hard and bitter and she knew at once it must have been cold and wet in the night. She kept kicking and soon enough the ball was flying between the posts and into the net. Jenna grinned, the feeling was amazing! She continued for a few more minutes before she got tired. She was still smiling when she said goodbye to the structure and walked back towards her dad.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Jack. He was always very creative and loved trying to find new ways of doing things. 

One day, Jack wanted to get a fancy new name. He was tired of the same old name, Jack. He wanted something a bit more creative!

So Jack asked his mum, "Mum, can I get a new name?" His mum said kindly, "Hmmm... I don't know, Jack. What kind of name do you want?" 

Jack thought long and hard, and then replied,  "I want something special, something creative!"

His mum said, "Well okay, why don't we try out some new names and see what fits?" She thought and then said, "How about 'James'?" 

Jack liked it. He grinned and said, "James! That's a perfect name for me. Can I get it please, mum?" 

His mum nodded and smiled. She said, "Of course you can, Jack. From now on, you shall be known as James!" 

And so, Jack became James! He was so happy with his new, creative name.

Timmy was playing in the park one day when he saw a modern toilet. His eyes lit up with excitement and he ran towards it. But when he went to open the door he found it was locked. Timmy started to cry. Then he heard a voice from inside the toilet. It was an old grumpy man.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Julia. She was always excited to play outside with her friends. One day when she went out to play, she saw a large pond. Julia was happy to have made a new friend that day. From then on, when the sun was setting, she would dive into the pond to see the rainbow. Every time, she felt more and more tired, but she still had fun every time.

One day, a little girl named Coco was outside playing in the rain. She was so excited that she decided to march in circles around the big pond next to her house. She jumped in puddles and splashed her body as she marched. 

As she marched, a big duck waddled towards her. Coco stopped in her tracks and smiled. "Hello there!" she said to the duck. The duck quacked loudly back and responded, "Happy marching!"

Coco laughed and continued to march around the pond. She was having so much fun that she didn't realize just how wet she was getting. After a while, she stopped and looked down at her body. It was drenched! 

She made her way back home and changed her clothes. After a tasty lunch, Coco was warm and cozy, and very happy she had taken the time to march in the rain.

She had learned to recognize the knife and to respect it.

One morning, Jack was walking in the park. He was feeling very happy and was singing as he walked. Suddenly, he heard a noise.

One day there was a young girl named Sarah. She was walking through the park with her mum when she saw something that made her stop in her tracks. Her Mother smiled and told her she could, but that they would need to go home first to get a basket. After picking up the basket from their house, they walked back to the park. 

Sarah was very happy. She raced to the tree and stretched her hands up to pick the closest one she could reach. But when she pulled her hand back the cherry was gone, leaving a branch full of empty stems where it had been.

Sarah was amazed. She asked how her Mum had known where to find the cherry, but her Mum just kept smiling. If Sarah had only realised earlier, she could have had the cherry much sooner!
